title: Maximum of Three Numbers using Ternary

content.problemStatement: Write a Program to find max of three nos using Ternary Operator

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '12 10 11' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '10 400 100' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find maximum of three numbers using nested ternary operators.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Use (a > b) ? ((a > c) ? a : c) : ((b > c) ? b : c) to determine the largest value.

hints: Nest ternary operators to compare three values.
First compare a and b, then compare the winner with c.
learningObjectives: Reason about multi-way decision trees in expressions.
Avoid common operator precedence errors in conditional operators.
